A soothing herbal tea blend for relaxation and gentle digestive support. All herbs grown on our farm.

Our Chamomile Lavender Tea is a gentle and aromatic blend perfect for unwinding at the end of the day. Both chamomile and lavender are grown and dried on our farm for maximum freshness and potency.

## How to Prepare

Steep 1 tablespoon of tea in 8 oz of hot water (just below boiling) for 5-10 minutes. Cover while steeping to keep the aromatic volatile oils in your cup. Enjoy plain or with a touch of honey.

## Ingredients

Farm-grown chamomile flowers, farm-grown lavender buds.

A classic bitter formula to support healthy digestion. Features dandelion root, gentian, and aromatic herbs from our farm.

Pure single-herb echinacea tincture made from farm-grown Echinacea purpurea root and flower. Classic immune support.

A zesty, immune-boosting apple cider vinegar tonic with horseradish, garlic, ginger, and hot peppers. A fall and winter staple.

A soothing herbal salve for dry skin, minor cuts, scrapes, and irritation. Made with farm-infused calendula and comfrey.
